New Calendly logo

Branding·by @mikesmith187·2026-08-20·inspora page·original post

What it is

New Calendly logo: a brand-identity reel cycling the new Calendly mark - concentric rounded-square rings forming a 'C' - across dreamlike contexts: navy on blurred pastel skies, white on lifestyle photos, a pencil construction sketch, a blueprint grid, the icon system (hourglass, wave, handshake, calendar), the wordmark lockup with 'Make space for what matters.', and an enamel pin render on paper.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Navy blue concentric-C mark centered on a soft-focus pastel sky (blue/pink/yellow clouds).
15-35%
White knockout mark over a desk/workspace photo; brand pattern (concentric rings) bleeds at frame edges over flowers/sky imagery.
35-50%
Pencil sketch of the mark's construction; then a white workspace where the logo sits beside a tiny toolbar and the tagline.
50-70%
Mark on washed peach gradient; blueprint view - cyan logo on blue with alignment guides, annotations, 'Calendly' label.
70-100%
Icon family sheet (4 glyphs, named); navy mark with color-blocking cards; construction grid; glossy cyan enamel pin on paper.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a brand-identity reel for the new Calendly logo - the concentric rounded-square rings forming a "C" cycled across dreamlike contexts: navy on blurred pastel skies, white knockout on lifestyle photos, a pencil construction sketch, a blueprint grid, the icon system sheet (hourglass, wave, handshake, calendar), the wordmark lockup with "Make space for what matters.", and an enamel pin render on paper.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Sequence of full-frame scenes: navy concentric-C on soft-focus pastel sky; white knockout over desk photo; brand pattern (concentric rings) bleeding at frame edges; pencil construction sketch; white workspace with logo + tiny toolbar + tagline; washed peach gradient; blueprint view (cyan mark on blue with alignment guides + annotations); icon family sheet (4 named glyphs); color-blocking cards; construction grid; glossy cyan enamel pin on paper.

## Motion spec
Pattern: ambient slideshow.
- ~1.5s per scene; transitions are hard cuts or gentle crossfades (300ms ease-in-out) - alternating keeps rhythm.
- Subtle ken-burns drift (scale 1 -> 1.03) within photo scenes.
- The C-mark itself never animates; it is the constant.

## Calibration
- 1.5s per scene: a reel, not a carousel - no controls, no pausing.
- Mix cuts and crossfades; uniform fades make it monotonous.
- Ken-burns is barely-there (3% scale); more becomes a slideshow screensaver.

## Reduced motion
Scenes swap with instant cuts, no drift.

## Don't miss
- Scene variety IS the piece: photo, sketch, blueprint, icon sheet, physical pin - the mark must survive every context.
- The construction scenes (sketch, blueprint with guides) carry the design-credibility weight.
- The enamel pin on paper closes the reel - physical artifact as the final proof.
